title: So much fun!
body: I have used a LOT off productivity apps over the years. Todoist, click up, asana just to name a few. I’ve even tried to use Evernote, apple reminders as well. I love Llama life because it is so easy to use and it’s great fun. I love how customisable it is. If you use the pomodoro technique you will find this super helpful. Great app. Check it out. It’s a lot of fun 😎🙌

author: angelesBrun

title: iOS experience is seamless
body:
Long time web browser Llama Life user here, and the iOS app fails to disappoint. It feels incredibly smooth. It’s a delightful experience. 

Llama Life has been my favourite todo/timeboxing app due to its clean, pleasing aesthetic, without all the bloat and bulkiness of the bigger todo list apps. It suits my lifestyle and workflow neatly without a huge amount of setup time or mental overhead.

title: *Unique* and helpful to-do list!!!
body:
Using Llama Life has helped me stay focussed, achieve more and stress less! As an ADHDer working remotely in an extremely flexible, self-managed role, I really struggle with prioritising & productivity. Here’s a selection of my favourite benefits from this app:
- the layout helps me overcome decision paralysis
- I feel less overwhelmed & can just tackle one task at a time
- seeing the timer helps me dodge my time-blindness & understand where I’m getting bogged down
- the optional ‘nag’ chime works so well - brings me back on track sooner & more reliably
- the whole vibe of Marie & the team at Llama Life really makes me feel excited, encouraged & supported.

Check it out - whether or not you have ADHD, this might just be the to-do list for you.
author: Ali92wa

title: Life changer
body:
Before llama, I genuinely couldn’t get anything done…

I was sinking. Work was a nightmare. Study was worse. 

I had tried all the apps. They just didn’t work for me.

But now, I feel like I can for the first time get things done! And llamas are so cute! I love llamalife 🦙🦙🦙
